name: Why do drywall cracks frequently appear in Denver-area basements?

mainEntity.name: Why do drywall cracks frequently appear in Denver-area basements?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basement drywall cracks commonly occur due to standard house settling, seasonal temperature swings, or soil movement, which is particularly frequent in Colorado’s expansive clay soils around the Denver area. Foundation shifts place uneven stress on framing studs, pulling apart taped joints or cracking the gypsum board. Other frequent causes include minor roof or plumbing leaks running down behind basement walls, vibration from overhead living spaces, or poor initial taping during basement finishing. Persistent or widening cracks indicate that structural movement or hidden moisture should be evaluated prior to cosmetic patching.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cracks often stem from house settling and shifting expansive soils common in the Denver area, as well as seasonal humidity shifts, roof leaks, or poor initial taping.
